title: OTP Authentication Success with Valid Phone Number
description: Verify that the OTP is successfully sent and verified when the user provides a valid phone number and enters the correct OTP within 5 minutes.

steps.description: Navigate to the login screen.
Enter a valid phone number.
Request an OTP.
Verify that an OTP is sent via SMS (Fast2SMS) and push notification (FCM) respecting user preferences.
Enter the correct OTP within 5 minutes.
Verify that the user is logged in and the session is persisted.

title: OTP Authentication Failure with Invalid OTP
description: Ensure that login fails when the user enters an expired or incorrect OTP.

steps.description: Navigate to the login screen.
Enter a valid phone number.
Request an OTP.
Verify that an OTP is sent.
Enter an incorrect or expired OTP.
Verify that login is rejected with proper error message.

title: Developer Bypass OTP Authentication
description: Verify that developer bypass works correctly allowing login without sending actual OTP for testing environments.

steps.description: Simulate developer bypass mode enabled.
Enter a valid phone number and request OTP.
Verify OTP is not sent via SMS or push but user can login using a bypass token/code.
Verify session is persisted and normal app flows continue.

title: OTP Rate Limiting Enforcement
description: Verify that the rate limiting on OTP requests prevents abuse by limiting the number of OTP requests per phone number.

steps.description: Attempt to request OTP repeatedly for the same phone number more than the allowed rate limit within a short period.
Verify that subsequent OTP requests are blocked and a proper rate limit error is shown.

title: Seller Product Creation with Approval Workflow
description: Verify seller can create a product and that the product is initially unapproved, requiring manual approval before appearing in customer catalog.

steps.description: Seller logs in via OTP.
Navigate to product management and create a new product with valid details.
Verify product is saved as unapproved and not visible in customer product catalog.
Verify product details are synced in real-time with Odoo ERP.

title: Seller Product Edit Triggers Re-Approval and Deactivation
description: Ensure that editing critical fields of a seller product deactivates it and triggers re-approval workflow.

steps.description: Seller logs in and edits an existing approved product's critical fields (e.g., price, description).
Verify the product is marked as unapproved and removed from customer catalog until re-approved.
Verify changes sync back to Odoo ERP with updated status.

title: Seller Product Filtering
description: Verify seller can filter their products by approval status, active status, and other attributes.

steps.description: Seller logs in and navigates to product list.
Apply filters for approval status (approved/unapproved) and active status.
Verify the product list updates correctly according to the filters.

title: Customer Product Catalog Displays Only Approved and Active Products
description: Verify that customer catalog shows only products which are both approved and marked active.

steps.description: Customer logs in.
Browse the product catalog.
Verify only products with approved=true and active=true are visible.
Verify unapproved or inactive products are not shown.

title: Shopping Cart Add, Update, and Remove Product Items
description: Verify that customers can add products to the cart, update quantities, and remove items with real-time sync and RLS enforced.

steps.description: Customer logs in and browses product catalog.
Add various products to the shopping cart.
Verify items appear correctly in cart with correct details and quantities.
Update quantities of cart items.
Verify quantities update correctly.
Remove items from the cart.
Verify removal is reflected immediately.
Verify Row Level Security enforces access so customers see only their own cart data.

title: Order Placement Success Flow
description: Verify that customers can place orders from the cart successfully and order information is saved properly.

steps.description: Add items to cart and navigate to checkout.
Provide delivery address using Google Maps integration.
Submit the order.
Verify order is recorded in the orders and order_items tables with correct details.
Verify customer receives order confirmation notification via SMS and push respecting preferences.
Verify order status is visible to customer.

title: Order Placement Failure on Missing/Invalid Fields
description: Verify that order placement fails gracefully if required fields like address or cart items are missing or invalid.

steps.description: Attempt to place an order with an empty cart.
Verify order is rejected with proper validation error.
Attempt to place an order with invalid or missing delivery address.
Verify order is rejected with proper validation error.

title: Real-time Synchronization of Seller Product Updates with Odoo ERP
description: Verify that any changes to seller products are synchronized in real-time with the Odoo ERP system and status updates from ERP are reflected back.

steps.description: Seller creates or updates a product.
Verify changes propagate to Odoo ERP within the SLA (<1 second).
Odoo ERP sends updated product status back (e.g., approval or stock changes).
Verify local product status and data update accordingly.

title: Admin Login with MFA and RBAC Enforcement
description: Verify that admin users must authenticate via MFA and their access is limited by role-based access control.

steps.description: Admin user navigates to admin web panel login.
Enter valid credentials and complete MFA challenge.
Verify login succeeds only after MFA validation.
Verify UI elements and permissions match admin user's role.
Attempt to access resources or actions not permitted to the admin role.
Verify access is denied with proper error messages.

title: Admin Panel: Traffic Monitoring and Webhook Log Access
description: Verify that admins can view API traffic logs and webhook event logs with filtering and sorting capabilities.

steps.description: Admin logs into admin panel.
Navigate to traffic monitoring and webhook logs sections.
Verify logs are displayed with timestamps, status codes, and request/response details.
Apply filters and sort logs by various fields (date, status, endpoint).
Verify filtering and sorting behave as expected.

title: Admin Panel: Feature Flags Management
description: Verify that admins can create, toggle, and delete feature flags and changes take effect immediately.

steps.description: Admin accesses feature flag management.
Create a new feature flag and enable or disable it.
Verify the flag is saved correctly and the system respects its status immediately in app behavior.
Delete an existing feature flag.
Verify deletion is successful and feature is no longer applied.

title: Notification Delivery Respecting User Preferences
description: Verify that notifications (OTP, order updates) are sent via SMS or push based on user preferences and delivery is logged.

steps.description: Simulate sending OTP and order update notifications to users with configured preferences.
Verify that users who opted for SMS receive SMS and those opted for push receive push notifications.
Verify notification delivery status is recorded accurately in the notifications audit logs.

title: Google Maps Integration for Address Management and Delivery Estimation
description: Verify that customers can add and select addresses using Google Maps autocomplete and that delivery fee is calculated accordingly.

steps.description: Customer navigates to address management.
Use Google Places autocomplete to enter address.
Verify valid address details are filled automatically.
Verify delivery fee calculation updates dynamically based on address location.
Delivery fee matches configured delivery_fee_configs pricing rules.

title: Audit Trail Logging for Critical Operations
description: Verify that all critical operations such as login, product changes, order placements, and admin actions are logged in admin_logs with relevant details.

steps.description: Perform critical actions such as login, product creation/edit, order placement, admin user role change.
Verify entries are created in admin_logs with timestamp, user, action type and status.

title: Cross-platform Compatibility of Customer and Seller Mobile App
description: Verify that the mobile app functions correctly on Android and iOS platforms with consistent UI and functionality.

steps.description: Install and launch the app on Android device.
Verify all major flows (login, catalog browsing, cart, order) work without issue.
Repeat the above test on iOS device.
Verify UI components render properly and functionalities match Android behavior.

title: Performance Testing: API Response and Admin Panel Load Times
description: Verify that API responses are within 500ms and admin panel page loads complete within 2 seconds under typical load.

steps.description: Send multiple typical API requests (e.g. product list, cart update) and measure response times.
Verify all API response times are <= 500 ms.
Load admin panel pages including dashboard, notifications, and moderation.
Verify pages load fully within 2 seconds.

title: Security Test: Row Level Security and API Key Enforcement
description: Verify that RLS policies enforce data isolation between customers and that API keys are required and validated for protected endpoints.

steps.description: Attempt to access customer cart and order data using another customer's credentials or token.
Verify access is denied due to RLS policies.
Make API calls to protected endpoints without or with an invalid API key.
Verify requests are rejected.

title: Deployment Verification of Admin Panel Build With API Key Protection
description: Verify that the production admin panel build is deployed correctly with target lib/main_admin.dart and configured API key protections are applied.

steps.description: Deploy admin panel using 'flutter build web --release --target=lib/main_admin.dart'.
Verify deployment successful and serves correct admin panel.
Verify API key protections prevent unauthorized web admin API access.

title: Notification Failure Handling and Retry Mechanism
description: Verify that notification sending failures (SMS or push) are detected, logged, and retried according to configured policies.

steps.description: Simulate failure in sending SMS via Fast2SMS or push via FCM.
Verify failure is logged in notification audit logs.
Verify system retries sending notification as per retry policy.
